purpose: Bound a canonical chart with a readable heading, description, and token-driven surface.
accessibility: Provide a meaningful heading and keep the chart's accessible name connected to its data.
Preserve chart keyboard and tooltip semantics supplied by the chart contract.
responsive: Keeps chart content bounded and readable in narrow containers.
Allows the chart implementation to own its responsive plot geometry.
motion: Delegates data animation to the chart contract.
Respects prefers-reduced-motion through the composed chart.

api.name: description
api.description: Supporting context for the chart surface.
